description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for the Git HTTP backend, specifically focusing on handling the CONTENT_LENGTH header and HTTP request processing. It includes setup steps, test definitions, environment configurations, and verification functions for various HTTP scenarios related to Git operations.

methods.name: verify_http_result
methods.description: Verifies the HTTP response status, specifically checking for fatal errors or correct status codes.

methods.name: test_http_env
methods.description: Sets up the environment and invokes the Perl script to simulate an HTTP request with specific content type and body.

methods.name: ssize_b100dots
methods.description: Calculates a size value exceeding the maximum ssize_t, used to test overflow handling.
